answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by forcing each new identity to lock a non-fungible marble of stake that unlocks only after graded work attestations arrive from an unrelated trust island. Attestation weight climbs a reputation ridge built from epoch-by-epoch original answers scored by disjoint peer panels, so every fake head needs its own external sponsors and cannot reuse one work graph. Cloning therefore multiplies locked capital and unique peer exposure instead of amortizing them.
